Use am with I, is with he/she/it, are with you/we/they. Short forms: I'm, you're, he's.
hungarian: Az I mellett am, a he/she/it mellett is, a you/we/they mellett are áll. Rövid alakok: I'm, you're, he's.

english: I, you, he, she, it, we, they replace names. Use he for a man, she for a woman.
hungarian: Az I, you, he, she, it, we, they a nevek helyett áll. He = férfi, she = nő.

english: What asks about things, Where about places, How about the way. The verb comes after the question word.
hungarian: A what dolgokra, a where helyre, a how módra kérdez. A kérdőszó után jön az ige.

english: Use a before a consonant sound, an before a vowel sound: a teacher, an apple.
hungarian: Mássalhangzó előtt a, magánhangzó előtt an: a teacher, an apple.

english: my, your, his, her, our, their show who owns something. His for a man, her for a woman.
hungarian: A my, your, his, her, our, their megmutatja, kié valami. His = férfié, her = nőé.

english: Add 's to a name: Kira's boyfriend = the boyfriend of Kira.
hungarian: Tegyél 's-t a név után: Kira's boyfriend = Kira barátja.

english: Use have with I/you/we/they and has with he/she/it.
hungarian: Az I/you/we/they mellett have, a he/she/it mellett has áll.

english: Add -s for more than one: one sister, two sisters. Some words change: child → children.
hungarian: Több dologhoz tegyél -s-t: one sister, two sisters. Néhány szó változik: child → children.

english: Use the base verb: I get up, they work. Add -s for he/she/it: she works.
hungarian: Alap ige: I get up, they work. He/she/it mellett -s: she works.

english: Use Do you...? and Does he/she...? Do not add -s to the main verb: Does she work?
hungarian: Do you...? és Does he/she...? A fő igéhez ne tegyél -s-t: Does she work?

english: These words usually come before the main verb: I always drink coffee.
hungarian: Ezek a szavak általában a fő ige előtt állnak: I always drink coffee.

english: There is for one thing, there are for more than one: There is a garden. There are two rooms.
hungarian: Egy dologhoz there is, többhöz there are: There is a garden. There are two rooms.

english: Use some in positive sentences, any in questions and negatives: I have some bread. Do you have any milk?
hungarian: Állításban some, kérdésben/tagadásban any: I have some bread. Do you have any milk?

english: I'd like = I would like. It is more polite than I want.
hungarian: I'd like = I would like. Udvariasabb, mint az I want.

english: Can + base verb: I can swim. Can't = cannot. Questions: Can you help me?
hungarian: Can + alap ige: I can swim. Can't = cannot. Kérdés: Can you help me?

english: be + going to + verb: I am going to visit Kira.
hungarian: be + going to + ige: I am going to visit Kira.

english: be + verb+ing for actions happening now: I am cooking. She is working.
hungarian: be + ige+ing a most történő cselekvésre: I am cooking. She is working.

english: at for times (at seven), on for days (on Monday), in for months (in July).
hungarian: at időpontra (at seven), on napra (on Monday), in hónapra (in July).

english: me, you, him, her, it, us, them come after the verb: Can you hear me?
hungarian: me, you, him, her, it, us, them az ige után áll: Can you hear me?

english: like/love/enjoy + verb+ing: I like cooking. She loves reading.
hungarian: like/love/enjoy + ige+ing: I like cooking. She loves reading.

english: Use the base verb alone: Turn left. Wait here. Add please to be polite.
hungarian: Csak az alap ige: Turn left. Wait here. Udvariasan: tegyél please-t.

english: Could you help me? asks someone to do something. Could I have...? asks for something for yourself.
hungarian: Could you help me? = kérsz vkit vmire. Could I have...? = kérsz magadnak vmit.

english: was with I/he/she/it, were with you/we/they: I was at home. They were happy.
hungarian: was: I/he/she/it, were: you/we/they. I was at home. They were happy.

english: Add -ed to many verbs: visited, cooked. Some change: go → went, have → had, see → saw.
hungarian: Sok igéhez -ed: visited, cooked. Néhány változik: go → went, have → had, see → saw.

english: need to / have to + base verb: I need to pack. I have to check in.
hungarian: need to / have to + alap ige: I need to pack. I have to check in.

english: Short words add -er: older, bigger. Long words use more: more interesting. Use 'than' to compare.
hungarian: Rövid szóhoz -er: older, bigger. Hosszú szóhoz more: more interesting. A 'than' köti össze.

english: and adds, but shows a difference, because gives a reason.
hungarian: and hozzáad, but ellentétet mutat, because okot ad.
